title: HY-OAS gap closed via credit proxy + +50% re-run — credit axis doesn't help
summary: No free source for real BAMLH0A0HYM2 (ICE HY OAS) — DBnomics 0 results, Nasdaq ML/HYOAS key-gated, ICE paywalled, FRED down. Approximated with -log(HYG/IEF) credit proxy (HY corp ETF vs duration-matched Treasuries, tracks OAS direction). Re-ran +50%/50d under the champion regime with the full 9-series panel, identical window to _260. Adding the credit axis slightly REGRESSED the cell (R-p@1 0.360->0.320, every K down). Credit-proxy features used but low-rank (~1.7% gain, #33); breakeven+nominal-yield dominate. Credit spread is NOT the missing piece; _260 verdict stands (macro does not beat the champion). Keep F17 opt-in, do not promote.
verdict: credit axis does NOT close the gap — slight regression (R-p@1 -0.04); macro (9 axes) still far below the champion; recommendation unchanged (keep F17 opt-in, do not promote)
